zh.title: 倫敦城市機場（LCY）跑道舉辦Nike夜間女子10公里賽 約5000人參賽
zh.summary: 倫敦城市機場（LCY）跑道10月17日舉辦Nike女子夜跑；機場稱賽事於非營運時段舉行，航班未受影響
body: 倫敦城市機場（LCY）在2026年10月17日把跑道的一部分用作Nike「After Dark Tour」倫敦10公里賽的賽道，這是一場夜間女子路跑賽事。AeroTime報導，這場活動把原本供飛機使用的路段交給跑者使用。
報導指出，這場賽事售出全部名額，約有5000名跑者參加，在機場跑道上比賽，並可看到倫敦天際線。倫敦城市機場只有一條跑道。
倫敦城市機場發言人向AeroTime表示，這場比賽是規劃好的活動，在機場營運時段之外舉行，航班沒有受到影響。
賽道起點與終點都在東倫敦皇家碼頭區的Silverworks Island。跑者沿著封閉道路經過碼頭區、Millennium Mills與水岸，之後才進入跑道。Nike形容這條平坦路線速度快，適合想追求個人最佳成績的跑者。
活動場地在當地時間15:00開放，跑者於18:30至19:00之間分四波出發，依預計完賽時間分組，範圍從50分鐘以內到兩小時。當晚活動還包括現場DJ、運動員主持人、博覽會，以及英國創作歌手Pink Pantheress現場演出的賽後慶祝活動。
比賽期間，Silverworks Island、皇家碼頭區與機場周邊實施滾動式道路封閉，主辦單位鼓勵參賽者與觀眾搭乘大眾運輸。
報導指出，倫敦是Nike 2026年After Dark Tour七個站點之一。該系列是Nike為女性舉辦的全球夜間跑步活動，結合競賽、音樂、社羣活動與賽後慶祝；Nike於2025年推出該系列，首年五個洲共七場賽事吸引超過5萬名女性參加。2026年巡迴同樣造訪七座城市，倫敦、上海、馬尼拉與孟買舉辦10公里賽，洛杉磯、墨西哥城與雪梨舉辦半程馬拉松。

en.title: London City Airport (LCY) runway hosts Nike After Dark women's 10K with about 5,000 runners
en.summary: London City Airport (LCY) runway hosted a Nike women's night race on October 17, 2026; airport says flights were unaffected
body: Part of London City Airport (LCY)'s runway became the course for Nike's After Dark Tour London 10K, a nighttime race for women, on October 17, 2026, AeroTime reported.
The sold-out event drew about 5,000 runners, who raced on the airport's runway with the London skyline in view. London City Airport has a single runway.
A London City Airport spokesperson told AeroTime that the race was a planned event held outside the airport's operational hours, and that there was no impact on flights.

The course started and finished at Silverworks Island in East London's Royal Docks. Runners followed closed roads through the docks, past the Millennium Mills and along the waterfront before heading onto the runway. Nike described the flat route as fast and suited to runners chasing personal bests.

The event site opened at 15:00 local time, with runners setting off in four waves between 18:30 and 19:00 local time, grouped by expected finishing times ranging from under 50 minutes to two hours. The evening also included live DJs, athlete hosts, an expo and a post-race celebration with a live performance by British singer-songwriter Pink Pantheress.
During the race, rolling road closures were in place around Silverworks Island, the Royal Docks and the airport, with organizers encouraging participants and spectators to use public transportation.

London is one of seven stops on Nike's 2026 After Dark Tour, the report said. The series is Nike's global nighttime running series for women, combining racing with music, community events and post-race celebrations; Nike launched it in 2025, when its first year drew more than 50,000 women across seven races on five continents. The 2026 tour also visits seven cities, with London, Shanghai, Manila and Mumbai hosting 10K races and Los Angeles, Mexico City and Sydney hosting half-marathons.

zh.title: FAA核發BETA Technologies A250特別適航證書 授權市場調查飛行
zh.summary: FAA核發BETA Technologies A250特別適航市場調查證書，授權市場調查飛行
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）宣佈，已向BETA Technologies核發特別適航市場調查證書，授權其ALIA eVTOL飛機（A250）執行飛行作業，供營運業者及參與者進行市場調查。
FAA表示，這項授權也擴大BETA Technologies的作業地理範圍，使飛機能在更多環境中飛行並蒐集更多資料。BETA Technologies創辦人暨執行長Kyle Clark表示，營運業者現在可親身體驗A250，並開始規劃如何將其納入業務。

en.title: FAA Issues BETA Technologies a Market-Survey Certificate for A250 eVTOL
en.summary: FAA authorizes BETA Technologies' A250 eVTOL for market-survey flight operations.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) says it has issued BETA Technologies a Special Airworthiness Market Survey Certificate for its ALIA eVTOL aircraft (A250). The certificate authorizes flight operations with operators and participants for the purpose of conducting market surveys.

The FAA said the authorization also expands the geographic scope of BETA Technologies' operations, allowing the aircraft to fly in more environments and gather more data. BETA Technologies founder and CEO Kyle Clark said operators can now experience the A250 firsthand and begin planning how it fits into their businesses.

zh.title: FAA擬對Creamer Pilot Services提出35.1萬美元民事罰款
zh.summary: FAA擬對Creamer Pilot Services處以35.1萬美元民事罰款
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）提議對位於 Fayetteville, Arkansas 的 Creamer Pilot Services處以35.1萬美元民事罰款。FAA指稱，該公司進行未經授權的載客營運。
FAA指稱，Creamer使用三架未列入其 Operations Specifications 的飛機執行31班載客航班，相關違規發生於 October 2021 至 July 2022 間。
FAA另指稱，Creamer使用兩架列於 Operations Specifications 的飛機執行六班載客航班，未經授權飛往美國本土48州以外地區；相關違規發生於 April 2022 至 November 2022 間。FAA稱，全部37項違規均是該公司明知、粗心且魯莽地進行。

en.title: FAA proposes $351,000 civil penalty against Creamer Pilot Services
en.summary: FAA proposes a $351,000 civil penalty against Creamer Pilot Services.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has proposed a $351,000 civil penalty against Creamer Pilot Services of Fayetteville, Arkansas, alleging unauthorized passenger-carrying operations.

The FAA alleges Creamer operated 31 passenger-carrying flights using three aircraft that were not on its Operations Specifications. The alleged violations occurred on various dates between October 2021 and July 2022.

The FAA also alleges Creamer conducted six passenger-carrying flights on two aircraft that were on its Operations Specifications but traveled outside the 48 contiguous United States without authorization. Those alleged violations occurred on various dates between April 2022 and November 2022. The FAA alleges all 37 violations were conducted knowingly, carelessly and recklessly.

zh.title: 達美航空訂購30架波音787-10，2031年前不接收任何一架
zh.summary: 達美航空訂購30架波音787-10，2031年前不接收任何一架
body: 達美航空已訂購30架波音787-10客機。Simple Flying標題指出，達美航空要到2031年才會接收其中任何一架；換言之，這批飛機不會在2031年前交付。標題所述的接收時間為2031年或之後。
Simple Flying摘要將等待時間描述為五年，並稱這段等待引發對替換、引擎及運能的疑問。摘要列出的關注面向包括替換、引擎與運能，並以疑問呈現這些面向，而非將其表述為已發生的結果。

en.title: Delta Air Lines Orders 30 Boeing 787-10s, With Deliveries No Earlier Than 2031
en.summary: Delta Air Lines orders 30 Boeing 787-10s; no aircraft before 2031
body: Delta Air Lines has ordered 30 Boeing 787-10 aircraft, according to the Simple Flying headline. The headline says the airline will not receive any of the aircraft until 2031. In other words, the stated timing puts receipt in 2031 or later, rather than before that year.

Simple Flying’s summary describes a five-year wait and says it raises questions about replacements, engines and capacity. It identifies those three topics as questions associated with the wait, rather than reporting them as outcomes. The stated order quantity, aircraft model and timing are presented alongside those issues.
